content: Spring Boot 3.2+ spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true (Java 21) makes applicationTaskExecutor virtual and auto-configures Rabbit listener container factories with a virtual-thread executor (Boot 3.2 M2, #36387). Known issue Boot #38563: SimpleMessageListenerContainer with concurrency > logical CPUs failed to start (consumersMonitor synchronized contention); Spring AMQP #2481 replaced trivial synchronized with locks in 3.1.1; SMLC consumersMonitor split to #2568. Mitigation: verify startup at chosen concurrency, or use DMLC.
